The breakwater lamp stays lit

The harbour board met on Tuesday evening to decide the future of the old breakwater lamp, which has guided boats past the reef for more than a century and a half without fail.

Members heard from fishermen, a retired keeper and two engineers, and the meeting ran well past the usual hour before anyone proposed a vote on the question.

The harbour board met on Tuesday evening to decide the future of the old breakwater lamp and it voted, narrowly, to keep it burning for at least another ten years of winters.
